# Copilot Instructions

Follow these instructions and hints when generating code in this repository.

## General Instructions

### C# Specifics

1. Avoid `#region` directives in C# code.
2. Use .NET 10 features and best practices.

### Vue.js Specifics
1. Use the Composition API with `<script setup>` syntax.
2. Use TypeScript for all Vue components.
3. Prefer `defineProps` and `defineEmits` for component props and events.
4. Use `<style scoped>` for component-specific styles.
5. Follow Vue.js style guide recommendations for naming conventions and file organization.
